{{Top|leg}}
The '''Great Geel''', also known as the '''Master Greel''' and the '''Geeloniran''' in the [[Geelan language]], was the ruler of the [[Geelan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and the species' various family groups, known as ''nests''. The Great Geel received a cut of all Geelan business transactions<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref> and presided over all business and contracts that involved the Geelan as a whole. Before the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] known as [[Zirtran's Anchor/Legends|''Zirtran's Anchor'']] [[The Vanishing|disappeared]], the Geelan named [[Whisk the Elder]], who went to confer with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Vence Tabok]] on said station, was rumored to be the Great Geel.<ref name="ZA">{{JournalCite|5|Zirtran's Anchor (article)}}</ref>
